items.title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
items.summary: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

items.title: Threatening emails sent to thousands of schools across UK, Ireland and Italy treated as hoaxes
items.summary: Threatening emails sent to thousands of schools across the UK, Ireland and Italy are being treated as hoaxes.

items.title: No risk to public from hoax school bomb threats, says government minister
items.summary: Police Scotland said at least 1,000 schools received the email but the warnings were immediately assessed as hoaxes.

items.title: British DJ named as one of six people killed in Krakow shooting
items.summary: A British DJ has been named as one of six people killed in a shooting in Krakow.

items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: Poundland directors to meet tonight to decide company's future, Sky News told
items.summary: The directors of Poundland will hold a board meeting tonight to decide the company's future, Sky News has been told.
